contributions.title: GitHub ci workflow
contributions.body:
**What This PR Does**
Adds a Github Action Workflow that runs mine run ci on every push and pull request to main
**Changes**

- Added .github/workflows/ci.yml

**CI checks includes**

- cargo fat --all -- -- check
- cargo clip -all-target -- -D warning
- cargo build
- cargo test --all-tar
